caption: A model rocket reaches the top of its flight, its nose pops off and a parachute unfolds, and the rocket drifts slowly down under the canopy.

sa.check: A model rocket reaches the top of its flight.
The rocket drifts slowly down under the canopy.
The nose comes off first, then the canopy opens, then the drift down.

pc.expect: The canopy fills above the rocket and the fall slows sharply the moment it opens.
pc.fail: The rocket keeps falling fast with the canopy open; or slows before the canopy; or the canopy opens below the rocket.

pc.expect: The rocket hangs below the canopy and descends, not rising.
pc.fail: It rises; or hovers indefinitely; or the rocket is above the canopy.
It drifts against visible wind; or straight down with visible wind; or jinks.

pc.expect: The canopy is cloth that fills and billows, and the cords are taut.
pc.fail: It is a rigid dome; or the cords are slack while hanging; or the canopy shreds.

pc.expect: One rocket and one parachute keep their number.
pc.fail: The rocket duplicates; or vanishes; or the parachute turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rocket's colours and the sky stay the same.
pc.fail: The rocket changes colour; or the canopy changes; or the field rearranges.
